intro: The Summoning is a warrior trial conducted by the mystic Bath'rah Windwatcher to call forth Cyclonian, the wind lord. By invoking and slaying the tempestuous elemental, a warrior claims the Whirlwind Heart to instill a weapon with the force of the storm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am ready to perform the ritual to summon Cyclonian. When he is summoned, you must defeat him and take his whirlwind heart. This I will use to instill a weapon with Cyclonian's power.
Friend, are you ready to face the wind lord?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, I must have the whirlwind heart!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You did it! You defeated Cyclonian and gained the Whirlwind Heart!
